summary: Independent probe 2026-11-21 (~03:44-04:05 UTC). Zero settled paid calls (sandbox burner unfunded: Base mainnet native 0, USDC 0), budget regulation <=$0.01 kept at $0.00. Findings. (1) Transport passport: initialize -> protocolVersion 2025-06-18 accepted, stateless (no Mcp-Session-Id header); tools/list free on lite (search_tools + call_tool) and full endpoint (1020 tools in one 1.79MB page, no cursor); full catalog snapshot + docs-all snapshot in evidence. (2) Challenge semantics: calling a paid tool without payment returns MCP result isError=true whose text is the x402 v2 PaymentRequired JSON (x402Version 2, error 'Payment required', resource.url = the MCP endpoint itself, extensions.bazaar with toolName/inputSchema discovery metadata, accepts[] with the two network options) — HTTP status stays 200; the plain-HTTPS path documented in the README uses HTTP 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED header instead. (3) Gate order: payment gate precedes argument validation — call_tool(url_parse, {url:12345}) and call_tool(cusip_validate, {cusip:'!!!not-a-cusip!!!'}) both return the same PaymentRequired challenge instead of a validation error, so an agent cannot learn its arguments are wrong without paying; unknown tool name returns RPC -32602 'Unknown tool' for free (MCP layer validates tool existence before the gate). (4) Signed submit: x402 v2 payload {x402Version, resource, accepted, payload:{authorization, signature}} built from the challenge (EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization, value=1000, validAfter/validBefore from maxTimeoutSeconds 300, nonce random) signed with a burner EOA over the challenge-supplied domain (USD Coin v2, chainId 8453, verifyingContract USDC) and submitted in params._meta['x402/payment'] -> server forwarded to the facilitator: verify returned invalid_exact_evm_insufficient_balance in 1.04s — the signature was VALID (not invalid_signature), the failure is the balance check, i.e. the payload shape and EIP-712 domain are correct end-to-end; the failed verify response carries the full fresh challenge (same accepts, new terms) so the client can retry after funding. No settle transaction, no charge; burner balance 0/0 before and after (evidence 21). (5) 'If the tool fails, you're not charged': pre-payment failures are free by construction (no payment token in the request); the post-payment refund/settle-on-failure path requires a funded wallet and is UNVERIFIED in this run — the observable equivalent is that no settle ever occurred without a valid payment (facilitator balance-gates before settle).
